summary: Noether R120 German source-audit working package. R120 closes Paper 31 from 23 native 600-PPI GDZ IIIF page witnesses, supplies a 455-page German cumulative reader and a 15-page Paper 31 slice, and changes the active source policy so lower-resolution genuine source witnesses are treated as actionable best-effort audit material rather than permanent blockers. A separate P21/P23 source-upgrade packet adds native 600-PPI GDZ witnesses for later visual re-audit. These are working draft/source-audit/provenance materials only, not a critical edition, not whole-corpus mathematical certification, and not synchronized multilingual propagation.

packages.status: R120 package with German cumulative TeX/PDF, standalone Paper 31 TeX/PDF slice, current 23-page source witness, raw 600-PPI GDZ JPEG source pages, source manifest, closure/page/equation/source-quality ledgers, render checks, diffs, logs, and source-policy note.
Separate cumulative source-witness PDF referenced by the R120 package and distributed outside the lean ZIP because of size.

Source-acquisition/provenance upgrade for Paper 21 and Paper 23 using native 600-PPI GDZ IIIF witnesses. Enables later visual re-audit but does not itself patch the TeX or certify P21/P23 under the stricter local 650+ PPI rule.
